subject: Kimi and DeepSeek advice checked against current implementation
body: The useful ideas are posterior calibration, history-aware search, offensive pressure and adaptive computation. Corrections: hidden king attack bonuses already exist (500/40); default prior is non-uniform and systematic resampling exists; learned-prior NLL gain did not improve king-loss benchmark; protocol supplies no opponent ID; one realized hidden piece does not imply its pre-move probability should be 100%; numeric Elo gains are unmeasured. Review records proposed ablations and observation-only opening mining.
